whatsappMessage:
Hi Chauka - Dil se Desi Restaurant team,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.2★ reviews from over 1,100 diners in Boring Road, but you currently rely on third-party aggregator pages instead of an independent brand website for direct table bookings and party orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct table reservation, desi menu showcase, aur instant WhatsApp inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://chauka-patna-demo.web.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Chauka team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Chauka - Dil se Desi Restaurant on Boring Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! Humne ise specifically aapke desi dining vibe, menu categories, aur direct WhatsApp table booking ke sath design kiya hai taaki aap commission-heavy aggregators par depend kiye bina direct guest inquiries handle kar sakein. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual dishes aur pricing integrate karke ise poori tarah live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
